target-product-image.name: Target Plus (product images)
target-product-image.background: clean white for primary product image
target-product-image.notes: Target Plus partners typically prep catalog-grade squares near 2000×2000 on white for the primary shot. Practical ~10 MB working ceiling; quality 80 keeps zoom crisp without bloating the item feed.

temu-product-image.name: Temu seller product image
temu-product-image.background: white or clean product backdrop for main image
temu-product-image.notes: Temu listing rails commonly start near an 800×800 square with a tight practical ~5 MB weight. Quality 75 downscales studio exports so the seller upload accepts them on the first pass.

shein-product-image.name: SHEIN product card
shein-product-image.background: clean or on-model for fashion cards
shein-product-image.notes: SHEIN fashion cards favor a portrait 3:4 frame around 900×1200 rather than a Western 1:1 square. Practical ~5 MB weight; quality 78 keeps fabric texture honest for on-model shots.

wayfair-product-image.name: Wayfair supplier product image
wayfair-product-image.background: pure white for primary silo image
wayfair-product-image.notes: Wayfair supplier silo images sit comfortably at 1600×1600 on white for furniture and decor detail. Quality 84 preserves wood grain and upholstery weave under a practical ~10 MB ceiling.

mercari-listing-image.name: Mercari listing photo
mercari-listing-image.notes: Mercari resale listings read best as a 1:1 square around 1200×1200 in the app grid. Practical ~8 MB weight; quality 79 keeps thrifted-item detail sharp without slow mobile uploads.

depop-listing-image.name: Depop listing photo
depop-listing-image.notes: Depop’s square-first feed matches a 1080×1080 crop like Instagram. Practical ~5 MB weight; quality 76 keeps styled vintage flat-lays crisp while staying light for the mobile app.

linkedin-post-image.name: LinkedIn shared link / post image
linkedin-post-image.notes: LinkedIn shared-link and post cards render cleanly at a 1.91:1 landscape near 1200×627. Quality 82 keeps logos and headline text readable in the feed under a practical ~5 MB weight.

twitter-post-image.name: X (Twitter) in-stream post image
twitter-post-image.notes: X in-stream images crop toward a 16:9 landscape around 1200×675 in the timeline. Quality 81 holds text overlays without heavy recompression under a practical ~5 MB weight.

youtube-thumbnail.name: YouTube video thumbnail
youtube-thumbnail.notes: Custom YouTube thumbnails use a 16:9 frame at 1280×720 with a hard 2 MB upload ceiling. Quality 83 keeps bold face crops and text punchy while staying safely under the 2 MB limit.

threads-post-image.name: Threads post image
threads-post-image.notes: Threads favors a tall 4:5 portrait around 1080×1350 that fills more of the mobile feed than a square. Quality 77 keeps the post light under a practical ~5 MB weight before the app recompresses.
